question.text: Kaveri Macro Fund (Cat III AIF) is applying to SEBI for an overseas investment allocation. Assume existing cumulative allocations by all AIFs stand at USD 1,420 million. What is the MAXIMUM incremental allocation SEBI can grant to Kaveri within the current overall limit applicable to AIFs?

answer.text: There is no cap on overseas investments by Cat III AIFs

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI's overall cap for overseas investment by all AIFs is USD 1,500 million, allocated on a first-come-first-served basis. With USD 1,420 million already utilised, the residual is 1,500 - 1,420 = USD 80 million. At the scheme level, an additional cap of 25% of investable funds also applies. The Trap: Option B (USD 580 million) reverses the subtraction. Option C restates the total cap but ignores prior allocations. Option D contradicts the overall ceiling. Note: SEBI's approval letter is valid for a defined window; unused limits are reallocated. Funds must report utilisation to SEBI within the prescribed reporting timeline.
